title: Develop your map
summary: Shape geometry, add objects, and give the scene atmosphere. Work on a saved practice map.

steps.title: Shape and clip brushes
steps.checkpoint: I can preview and commit a cut, then undo it.

steps.title: Create and sculpt terrain
steps.checkpoint: I can reshape terrain using the available sculpt tools.

steps.title: Place models
steps.checkpoint: I can place a loaded model and adjust its transform.

steps.title: Reuse prefabs
steps.checkpoint: I understand how to place and inspect a prefab.

steps.title: Add gameplay entities
steps.checkpoint: I can place a supported gameplay entity and find its properties.

steps.title: Set sunlight and sky
steps.checkpoint: I can find the sunlight and sky settings for my map.

steps.title: Place sound
steps.checkpoint: I can configure a sound emitter and understand preview limits.

steps.title: Organize the scene
